name: Lumisar
summary:
Lumisar is a PvP-focused fantasy MMORPG set in a persistent, seamless world without loading screens. Players choose from six races — Arin, Lumir, Shadir, Gorgar, Krahtar and Lumisari — each tied to its own kingdom, culture and class paths.

The core loop is built around kingdom building, territory control and warfare. Players form clans and alliances, contest castles and regions, and defend them through sieges. Combat is target-based and party-oriented, with dedicated support, buff and crowd-control roles rather than solo-focused action.

The game is built in Unreal Engine 5.8 on a custom authoritative server architecture, designed for large-scale battles within a single contiguous world.
